entries.text: For home and cottage bakers who sell at markets: price each loaf to cover ingredients, packaging, fees and your time, and see whether each market day was worth it.
Pricing from the flour bill alone leaves out your time, the bags and the stall fee. It is easy to underprice for fear of losing regulars, especially with other bakers at the next table.
You know what you are paying yourself per hour, your prices have a reason behind them, and after each market the log tells you what sold, what was left and what to bake next time.
Enter a recipe's ingredients and weights, and the calculator works out the cost per loaf. Add your time to see the price that pays you.
entries.note: Check against the live calculator's actual inputs before shipping.

entries.text: Costs your recipes by baker's percentage, builds card fees into each price, sets wholesale, market and pre-order prices, and logs every market day: baked, sold, wasted, stall fee, mileage and profit. Includes a printable stall price list and a worked sourdough example.
